name: vinvoice
description: VINvoice: an open convention for vehicle data in EN 16931 e-invoices. Registry, schemas, test corpus, reference checker and website.

scripts.dev: npm run generate && astro dev --root site
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run generate && astro build --root site
scripts.test: npm run validate && node scripts/test-generated.mjs && npm run test:checker
